messages.source: Q02 map, Supporting row Strict Mode
messages.msg: Lecture 2 tells the reader that with Strict Mode on (the default main.jsx of a Vite project) each console.log in a component body appears twice in development, and promises that Lecture 12 explains why. Lecture 2 names Strict Mode only as a development check; please give the full reason there and cite Lecture 2.
messages.resolution: Map 12's strict-mode-twice gives the full reason for the doubled logs (Strict Mode calls each component twice in development and keeps one result, to catch impure calls; the production build calls once) and cites Lecture 2.
